title: Circle Angle Vocabulary Assessment
description: Show mastery of circle angle vocabulary and basic circle diagram terms.

questions.question: In circle O, segments OA and OB are radii. What kind of angle is angle AOB?
questions.explanation: Angle AOB has vertex O at the center of the circle, so it is a central angle.

questions.question: Which statement best defines an arc?
options: A straight segment through the center
A line that never touches the circle
A connected part of the circle's curved edge
questions.explanation: An arc is a connected curved portion of a circle.

questions.question: A chord must pass through the center of the circle.
questions.explanation: A chord only needs both endpoints on the circle. A chord through the center is a diameter.

questions.question: A chord that passes through the center of a circle is a ____.
questions.explanation: A diameter is a chord through the center of the circle.

questions.question: A line meets a circle at points R and S. Which term describes the line?
questions.explanation: A line that intersects a circle at two points is a secant.

questions.question: A line touches a circle only at point T. What is point T called?
questions.explanation: The single contact point between a tangent and a circle is the point of tangency.

questions.question: A secant can contain a chord between its two intersection points with the circle.
questions.explanation: The segment connecting the two intersection points of a secant is a chord.

questions.question: The shorter arc between two points on a circle is called a ____ arc.
questions.explanation: A minor arc is the shorter arc between two points on a circle.

questions.question: Which pair of terms is most directly separated by the number of points where a line meets the circle?
questions.explanation: A secant meets the circle at two points, while a tangent meets it at exactly one point.

questions.question: Why is every diameter a chord, but not every chord a diameter?
questions.correctAnswer: Every diameter has endpoints on the circle, so it is a chord. Not every chord is a diameter because a chord does not have to pass through the center.
questions.explanation: The center condition is what makes a chord a diameter.

questions.question: A student says, 'Line l is tangent because it crosses the circle twice.' Correct the student's statement.
questions.correctAnswer: The line is not tangent; it is a secant. A tangent touches a circle at exactly one point, while a secant crosses it at two points.
questions.explanation: Crossing at two points is the defining feature of a secant, not a tangent.

questions.question: Which clue is enough to identify angle XYZ as a central angle?
options: Point X is on the circle
Point Y is the center of the circle
Point Z is outside the circle
questions.explanation: The middle letter names the vertex. If Y is the center, angle XYZ has its vertex at the center and is a central angle.
